anomalies.description: A person in an orange protective suit repeatedly strikes the head of a large beached whale with a long tool (likely a harpoon or gaff), causing visible blood and tissue damage; the whale is motionless and clearly helpless.

A person in an orange protective suit repeatedly strikes the head of a large, stranded, motionless whale with a long metal tool (likely a harpoon or gaff), causing visible blood and tissue damage; the whale shows no movement or defensive response, indicating it is helpless or deceased.; The person stops striking, steps back, and walks away from the whale while still holding the tool; the whale remains immobile on the shore with visible injuries and blood, confirming its helplessness during the prior assault.
